theorems.statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (h : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < s → s ≤ 1 → AEStronglyMeasurable h (volume.restrict (Ioo (1 - s) (1 + s))) → (∀ r : ℝ, |r - 1| < s / 4 → ∀ᵐ u, u ∈ Ioo (1 - s / 2) (1 + s / 2) → h (r * u) = r * h u) → ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ᵐ v, v ∈ Ioo (1 - s / 8) (1 + s / 8) → h v = c * v
